digest.component_or_area: maintenance audit runbook and janitor skill adapter
propositions: The maintenance audit runbook must be rewritten as a rebar-project adapter delegating to the packaged janitor workflow instead of embedding dated tool inventory and capture debris as maintained procedure.
Project-specific gate commands and their inputs must remain documented and executable in the adapted runbook.
The module limit must be stated as an absolute CI gate sourced from .github/module-size-limit.txt rather than a soft cap.
Durable progress and decisions for audit phases must be recorded in rebar session logs and tickets rather than in the runbook procedure itself.
Historical audit findings must reference prior tickets for context rather than restating incident narratives within maintained procedure.
Documented read-only commands including complexity checks, documentation index checks, and link validation must pass verification.
